Why Smartodo

Privacy-first productivity with an AI boost

Dependency graph

See blockers before they slow work down.

Track task relationships in a live dependency graph that stays in sync with your board.

Smart AI Agent

Turn one sentence into a linked plan.

Smart AI Agent creates tasks, links their dependencies, and updates priorities and due dates when you ask.

Powerful Filters

Ask your list exactly what you need.

Combine status, importance, title, due dates, and dependencies with AND / OR, like everything still blocking a release that's due this week.

Local-first

Works offline. Syncs through storage you own.

Every edit saves on your device first, then syncs through your own Google Drive or WebDAV.

Our server only relays a change signal, so your devices update in real time.
